## Mexican Regional Folk Dance (*Danza Regional Mexicana*)

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8}
I actively practice and perform **danza regional mexicana**. Mexican folk dance is a vibrant discipline that connects tradition, rhythm, identity, and cultural storytelling from diverse regions across Mexico.

Practicing folk dance provides a creative outlet, physical discipline, and a deep appreciation for regional cultural heritage alongside my scientific work.
:::

## Classical & Contemporary Literature

I am an avid reader with a deep interest in literature that explores human nature, society, and personal introspection. Some of my favorite literary works and authors include:

* **Hermann Hesse** — *Der Steppenwolf* (*El lobo estepario*)
* **Ray Bradbury** — *Fahrenheit 451*
* **Classical & Philosophical Fiction** — Exploring narratives on identity, society, and existential themes.

> *"Literature offers a reflective space to contemplate complex human experiences—a valuable perspective that enriches scientific inquiry."*

---

## Music & Piano

Learning to play the **piano** is one of my ongoing personal projects. Playing music requires a unique combination of structural practice, pattern recognition, and artistic interpretation—skills that complement the analytical mindset needed in bioinformatics.
